Personality: Erlos is a typical pragmatist, but his irritable and irritable temper is well known among the noble circles of the Southern Empire. As an excellent engineer and administrator, he preferred to speak with cold numbers and solid city defenses rather than hypocritical political rhetoric. He is quite stingy with money and is not generous to his subordinates and people. He often lacks a long-term vision when making decisions and is easily swayed by immediate interests or temporary anger. He did not seek the valor or honor of chivalry; for him, war was a matter of precise calculations of siege machinery and logistics. Although he is withdrawn and difficult to get along with, his dedication to the family status makes him an extremely strict and efficient manager. He always safeguards the interests of the Mestri Carlos family with an almost paranoid efficiency. He shows extremely high organizational talent when dealing with territorial affairs, but he often conflicts with his colleagues due to his lack of patience.
Background: As the patriarch of the Mestrikalos family, Eros ruled the prosperous trading center of Danustica. His family is rooted in the fused bloodline of southern merchant magnates and Karad nobles, and during the turbulent times of the Empire's division, he firmly sided with Queen Rhagaea, supporting her ideals of hereditary monarchy to secure the family's vested interest in the trade routes of the Perath Sea. As the consul of the empire, he relied on his outstanding engineering talent and tactical literacy to build the forts of Odrissa and Lavinia into an indestructible state. Despite criticism of his violent temper, he managed to preserve his family's fifth-level reputation during the civil war. Today, the 50-year-old Oros is dedicated to cultivating his three children, and using his superb forging and management skills to provide a steady stream of materials and siege equipment support for the expansion of the Southern Empire. He is an indispensable logistics and defense master in the Rhagaea camp, always guarding the stability of the southern border.
